description: Defines the GatewayConnectionIssue enum, representing various connection issues related to a gateway, along with associated logic for detecting and extracting specific information from textual status descriptions.

methods.name: detect(from:)
methods.description: Static method that analyzes a status text string to determine the specific connection issue, returning an appropriately categorized enum case.

methods.name: extractRequestId(from:)
methods.description: Private static method to extract an optional request ID from a status message, used in pairing-required scenarios.
